correctness.rationale: For the repaired claim, the forest encoding is bijective: choose at most one outgoing incidence per source, and reject directed cycles (including opposite arcs on one edge). An independent enumeration gives the face vector (1,24,234,1192,3357,4968,3024). The already known nonequivariant wedge type concentrates reduced homology in degree five. It was independently reverified by a 12,799-face Hasse sort and signed integral elimination, giving 6,181 matched pairs, critical dimensions 0,4,5 with counts 1,2,434, and pivot columns (−1,0) and (0,1). The signed fixed-face sum for a fixed face contributes (−1) to the power of its number of arc orbits after the odd homological-degree sign, including +1 for the empty face. All 144 elements' traces and the class-weighted inner products independently reproduce the repaired tables. Specht modules give absolutely irreducible rational outer products, so the decomposition is over Q, not just a complex character match. The repaired record claims no equivariant wedge splitting.
residual_risks: The exhaustive calculation is for this one graph; no equivariant homotopy or integral lattice claim follows.

originality.rationale: This is a fresh assessment of the character-only repair. The frozen record's presentation of the ordinary wedge classification as new fails originality on that component: an earlier indexed full result states and integrally proves exactly the same homotopy type. The repair removes it as a finding, cites it as the input for concentration, and retains only the full rational character and irreducible multiplicities. The exact earlier comparison gives no such character. A shorter independent Morse certificate corroborates the prior baseline but does not restore novelty to the frozen wedge claim.

value.rationale: The surviving finding resolves a natural finer question for the complete bipartite graph whose Morse homotopy type is already known: how the full bipartition automorphism group acts on the 432 independent rational homology classes. The exact character determines traces on every symmetry class, multiplicities of all irreducibles and, in particular, the two invariant dimensions. These provide exact data for any later equivariant treatment or subgroup restriction; the ordinary wedge count does not. The claim is a complete invariant of this rational action rather than a one-off trace at a selected permutation.
residual_risks: The value is confined to the full rational action on this natural graph, not a general formula or an equivariant homotopy classification.
